description: IPC for the quick capture window (label `capture`). It runs our own frontend bundle, matched exactly on that label like the chat window; browser-* windows (remote content) still match no capability at all. What it actually calls: capture_window_ready / capture_window_hide / capture_window_resize / capture_to_main / vault_current / notes_list / folders_list / files_list / privacy_list / query_blocks / note_create / attachment_save / files_import / clipboard_probe / clipboard_image / settings_get.
